1. (Currently Amended) A method for providing an electronic value certificate to a mobile device, the method comprising: utilizing a certificate selection device to generate electronic certificate selection information; providing the electronic certificate selection information and associated recipient data to a merchant server; receiving, from the merchant server, electronic value certificate data derived from the certificate selection information and the associated recipient data; establishing a communications link with a mobile device corresponding to the recipient data; and provisioning the electronic value certificate data on the mobile device over the communications link via over the air (OTA) communications.

13. (Currently Amended) A system for electronically providing an electronic value certificate to a mobile device, the system comprising: a merchant server for receiving certificate selection information related to the selection of an electronic value certificate and associated recipient data from a certificate selection device and generating electronic value certificate data; and an over the air (OTA) provisioning server for receiving the electronic value certificate selection data from the merchant server, establishing a communications link with a mobile device associated with recipient data, and provisioning the electronic value certificate data to the mobile device over the communications link via over the air (OTA) communications.

25. (Currently Amended) A non-transitory computer readable medium having stored thereon computer executable instructions that when executed by a processor of a computer performs steps comprising: utilizing a certificate selection device to generate electronic certificate selection information; providing the electronic certificate selection information and associated recipient data to a merchant server; receiving, from the merchant server, electronic value certificate data derived from the certificate selection information; establishing a communications link with a mobile device corresponding to the recipient data; and provisioning the electronic value certificate data on the mobile device over the communications link via over the air (OTA) communications. 

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises an SMS (short message service) message containing a URL (uniform resource locator) link to a web page displaying a barcode.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises a control SMS (short message service) message instructing the mobile device to download at least one barcode image of at least one coupon associated with the certificate selection information.

17. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises an SMS (short message service) message containing a URL (uniform resource locator) link to a web page displaying a barcode.

18. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises a control SMS (short message service) message instructing the mobile device to download at least one barcode image of at least one coupon associated with the certificate selection information.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the mobile device comprises a first NFC (near field communication) enabled device, and is configured to transfer the electronic value certificate to a second NFC (near field communication) enabled mobile device.

24. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 wherein the mobile device comprises a first NFC (near field communication) enabled device, and is configured to transfer the electronic value certificate to a second NFC (near field communication) enabled mobile device.
